text: relay-dsh-plugin-skill-creator 是一款面向 DSH 的 Skill 扩展，通过注册 bundled Skill provider，把 conversation-to-skill 提供给 DSH 的技能发现与加载流程。它可从当前对话提炼可复用工作流，先整理目标、输入输出、步骤与验收条件，再提出目录结构和文件方案，等待用户确认后生成 Skill，并按流程验证、报告未验证项。适合希望把有成果的多轮对话整理成可复用技能的 DSH 用户。当前代码展示的是技能提供与内容加载入口，不需要额外 API Key。

relay-dsh-plugin-skill-creator registers the bundled conversation-to-skill Skill with DSH. It turns a useful conversation into a reusable workflow, proposes files and acceptance criteria, then creates and validates the Skill after confirmation. The inspected implementation declares no API key.
想把一段有成果的 DSH 对话整理成以后能重复使用的技能
如何把对话里的步骤和修正变成一套可复用流程？
让 DSH 根据当前会话生成带说明和验收标准的 Skill
我想保存这个工作流，之后遇到类似任务可以直接复用
Turn a successful DSH conversation into a reusable skill.
Can I convert the workflow and corrections from a chat into a validated Skill?
relay-dsh-plugin-skill-creator 的功能「从对话提炼 Skill」：从当前对话整理目标、步骤和验收条件，形成可复用技能方案。
relay-dsh-plugin-skill-creator 的功能「先审阅方案再创建」：展示技能用途、目录和文件计划，等待用户确认后才写入。
relay-dsh-plugin-skill-creator 的功能「验证技能包」：生成后运行结构验证，并汇报实际验证和未验证项目。
relay-dsh-plugin-skill-creator 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 68 天；提交数 5；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

relay-dsh-plugin-skill-creator README · relay-dsh-plugin-skill-creator：A public DeepSeek Harness plugin that registers `conversation-to-skill`: a bundled Skill for turning a completed DSH conversation into a reusable, reviewed, and validated DSH Skill directory.

The generated bundle can include `SKILL.md`, `references/`, `scripts/`, and `assets/`. Resources are created only when the extracted workflow needs them.

relay-dsh-plugin-skill-creator README · Install in DSH：Add the public npm package to the DSH host and apply its bundled Cordis patch:

```bash
npm install relay-dsh-plugin-skill-creator
```

For repository development, installation from GitHub remains supported with `npm install github:yangbobo2021/relay-dsh-plugin-skill-creator`.

The included `cordis.patch.yml` inserts `relay-dsh-plugin-skill-creator` into the host configuration.

relay-dsh-plugin-skill-creator README · Use：At the end of a useful multi-turn DSH conversation, ask DSH to turn the conversation into a Skill or invoke `conversation-to-skill`. The Skill first converts user corrections into numbered requirement/evidence/test/oracle contracts, then proposes the target path, complete file tree, requirement coverage, exclusions, and validation plan. It writes only after explicit confirmation.

relay-dsh-plugin-skill-creator README · Use：Completion includes structural validation, a captured runtime PII-canary gate, generated-script checks, and DSH discovery. When Session creation is available, one fresh Session on the same DSH account tests natural routing and reuse; no cross-Agent accounts are required. Small bundles also carry proposal and generation token budgets whose overruns are reported honestly.
relay-dsh-plugin-skill-creator README · Use：V1 uses the conversation and artifacts visible in the current DSH context. It does not claim access to expired or hidden history.

relay-dsh-plugin-skill-creator README · Development：```bash
npm ci
npm run verify
```

The tests use the real DSH `SkillRegistry`, exercise the standalone validator, and inspect the package produced by npm.

See [SPEC.md](SPEC.md), [architecture](docs/architecture.md), [security model](docs/security.md), [acceptance matrix](docs/acceptance.md), and [DSH compatibility](docs/dsh-compatibility.md).

relay-dsh-plugin-skill-creator README · Releases：Version tags publish through GitHub Actions using npm Trusted Publishing (OIDC), with no long-lived npm token. See [the release guide](docs/releasing.md) for the one-time first-package bootstrap and publisher binding.
